events.speaker: caller
events.text: Social Security Administration, this is Agent Lowe. Your social number has been suspended due to fraud.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: A car rented in your name was found with narcotics. We have to protect your assets.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Take your funds out and buy Bitcoin at the ATM I'll direct you to. That money will be held in a government wallet.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Should I talk to my son first?

events.speaker: caller
events.text: This is confidential. You can't tell anyone or you'll be obstructing the case.
